title: Enforce trust-store revision origin and exhaustion
description: TrustStorePersistence accepts an existing serialized revision 0 even though every produced document starts at revision 1, and save() increments u64::MAX without a guard, writes revision 2^64, reports success, and leaves state unreadable on next load. Reject existing revision 0, surface explicit TrustStorePersistenceError at u64 exhaustion before writing, preserve prior bytes, and add boundary regressions.
